chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 299: The Heartbreaking Homecoming on Niuxin Mountain
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang arrives at Bai Lingmiao's hometown hoping for peace—but the village is silent and every door is closed. A crushing chapter of false hope and vanishing families.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 299 – Hope is a Punishment
og_description: After a long journey, Bai Lingmiao returns to find her village empty and her family gone. No blood. No violence. Just silence.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian 299 – Silence Cuts Deeper Than Any Monster
twitter_description: Bai Lingmiao's homecoming turns into a slow-burn horror of empty doors and unanswered cries. No one is home.

lore_anchors.definition: Literally “Ox-Heart Mountain,” the rustic name of Bai Lingmiao’s home village. The sweet pastoral image serves as a sharp contrast to the horror that follows.
The grumpy patriarch of the traveling opera troupe; gruff but deeply loyal to his family and Li Huowang.
A sycophantic, practical-minded fellow disciple of Li Huowang; pragmatic and cynical, he often provides dark humor.
A hirsute woman rescued from Danyangzi’s alchemy; she is practical, grounded, and fiercely defensive of the group.
In traditional Chinese society, a husband who moves into his wife’s family home, often seen as a loss of face and status.

cultural_notes_faq.a: Niuxin Mountain (Ox-Heart Mountain) is the name of Bai Lingmiao’s home village; it carries a pastoral, rustic charm that deliberately contrasts with the horror of its emptiness.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is there any violence in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No—the horror is entirely emotional and atmospheric: a sunny village, a joyful homecoming, and then silence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Lü Zhuangyuan want to speak alone?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He doesn’t want Bai Lingmiao to overhear the bad news about her missing family, showing a rare moment of protective tact.
